name: Ikisugi! M Lesson
source:
The main character is a college student and starts working as a private teacher to earn his living.
However, he is not well received at the houses he is sent to.
"Why do I have to be treated in this way!"
However, the job is well paid and he hesitates to let it by.
He collects himself and knocks the door of Shinohara family...

[from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE052153.html]DLSite English[/url]]
translation:
身为大学生的主人公为了赚取生活费，开始做起了上门家教的兼职。
然而每被派往一户人家，他都会遭到冷眼相待。
“凭什么我非得受这种窝囊气不可！”
可看在优厚时薪的份上，他又实在舍不得辞掉这份差事。
重振精神的主人公深吸一口气，敲响了下一户主顾——篠原家的大门……

[摘自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE052153.html]DLSite English[/url]]
